cover.title: Can AI Agents Really Browse Web?

slides.myth: AI agents surf the web like people.
slides.fact: They follow coded rules and APIs, not human curiosity or clicks.

slides.myth: AI agents freely access all websites.
slides.fact: They only access sites allowed by their programming and permissions.

slides.myth: AI agents understand web content fully.
slides.fact: They analyze data patterns but don’t comprehend context like humans.

slides.heading: AI Web Browsing Is Structured
slides.body: Agentic AI follows strict protocols to gather and act on web data.
